title: Check for balanced parentheses/brackets in an expression using a stack
hint: Push opening brackets onto a stack and on each closing bracket pop and check it matches; the stack must be empty at the end.

title: Implement a queue using two stacks
hint: Use an input stack for pushes and an output stack for pops, moving all elements across only when the output stack is empty.

title: Implement a Min Stack that returns the minimum element in O(1)
hint: Keep a second stack (or paired values) holding the minimum so far, pushing a new minimum whenever it is less than or equal to the current one.
